[SWS_Crypto_00264]
Crypto_CustomService returns the actual error value
of the KeyM_CertificateVerify ⌈If Crypto_ProcessJob() is called for an asyn-
chronous job configured with service CUSTOM_SERVICE that is mapped from a
KeyM API that will trigger KeyM_CertificateVerifyCallbackNotification() and if E_OK
or CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR will be returned in the Crypto_ResultType pa-
rameter, then uint8* secondaryOutputPtr shall contain the appropriate value from
Crypto_KeyM_CertificateStatusType data type.⌋
Note:
KeyM
distinguishes
between
KeyM_CertificateVerifyCallbackNotification()
and KeyM_ServiceCertificateCallbackNotification() callback functions having dif-
ferent data types of results, KeyM_ResultType and KeyM_CertificateStatusType.
The
configured
Csm_ApplicationCallbackNotification
provides
the
result
as
a
Crypto_ResultType
value.
In
case
of
an
unrecoverable
error,
e.g.
CRYPTO_E_BUSY, it is not possible to provide a value of KeyM_ResultType or
KeyM_CertificateStatusType.
Therefore, secondaryOutputPtr will only contain a
valid result for KeyM if the Csm_ApplicationCallbackNotification returns E_OK or
CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR.
